data.name: Tasty Beverage
data.detailed_description:
Tasty Beverage is a crew management game about growing your squad into large army controlling whole city blocks and defending it against attacking enemy factions.

Your crew is not special at the start. They are undertrained and poorly equipped. Level up members skills. Equip them and send them out on missions and repeat jobs. Each recruit can grow into a powerful unit. Keep it up until your squad can finally start causing real trouble and capture city blocks as turfs.

What Can You Do

  • Gain money, experience, weapons. You have to manage different resources as you upgrade your safehouse and get better weapons.

  • Earn money through jobs. Level up your members stats to unlock newer, more profitable higher level activities.

  • Acquire various tiers of weapons and armor by raiding enemies for supplies.

  • Rob ATMs, hit banks, fight off city police response before you can escape. Different factions have different types of units - such as riot police, SWAT teams, military forces.

  • Participate in turf wars to take over city districts from enemy crews control. Captured turfs give you passive income, although enemy crews will try to take it back periodically. 

  • Your every action can directly weaken enemy factions, or allows them to dynamically get stronger over time, if left unchecked.

  • Survive rival factions raids, robots, police lockdowns and other attacks as you gain notoriety and make newer enemies.

  • Use destructible buildings to your advantage - make breaches and openings to enemy safehouses during raids, or break through with armored van before disembarking for assault.

  • Buy cars for extra mobility during city action. Or steal one. Defend against enemy drive-bys, police cruisers and army truck infantry assaults.

  • You can recruit up to 8 core crew members in your direct active crew, after that you can recruit virtually unlimited additional garrisons for defending your turfs that patrol to defend against enemy crew incursions into your territory. These units patrol each controlled turf and can be made to follow you around in city to guard you or assist you in combat.

This description so far only describes what was added to the game already.
Tasty Beverage is actively receiving frequent updates. Updated on average weekly with new features that deepen the gameplay, fixing bugs and improving the smoothness of the game.

As a game developed by a solo dev, it will receive long term content updates like this for years to come, so current version is only a warmup, and I am open to hearing your ideas and suggestions at our Discord server! Cheers!

data.short_description: Run your own crime crew! What could possibly wrong? Recruit, train, and equip your squad. Earn money, survive raids from rival crews and strike back when ready. Conquer procedurally generated city and gradually gain influence and notoriety.
data.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese
